name: Princess☆Strike! ~Oshaberi☆Strike~ Perfect
original_name: プリンセス☆ストライク！ 〜おしゃべり☆ストライク〜 Perfect
source:
A mini-game from [url=/v4895]Princess☆Strike![/url] where you can chat with the heroines from the main game!
As you chat more, you'll be able to view event illustrations used in the main game and see them in their casual clothes.

[Edited from App Store]
